gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Chunky tube letters, loud and glowing. Noto Sans Tagbanwa sits next to Tilt Neon like a quiet neighbor, curves open and lowercase filling the line, while the heading does all the shouting.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Neon tubing, bold and unblinking. Tilt Neon holds one thick line from start to finish, while Noto Sans Tamil Supplement counters with round, parenthesis-like forms and a tall middle band that looks sturdy in sans-serif text.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tc: Approachable is the first thing Noto Sans TC says, with big open counters in its a, e and s. Tilt Neon gives the pair its punch, since the body curves outward gently while the heading keeps one tube-like line throughout.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps its rounded letters open and inviting, with lowercase bowls that fill each line like inflated shapes. Tilt Neon's tube lettering shouts above it, so the sans-serif text feels softer.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: One constant tube-like stroke defines Tilt Neon, like tracing a single thick thread. Noto Sans Tirhuta follows with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, so the sans feels lighter and more open beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Approachable and clean, Noto Sans Ugaritic sits low under the heading. Tilt Neon is at its best holding a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, while the body's open mouths and tight x-height to cap gap do the quieter work.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Tilt Neon's lowercase a has no thin hairlines anywhere, just one rounded tube of stroke from top to bottom. And Noto Sans Wancho matches that muscle, with a hulking lowercase like pressed chalk and an e left wide open at its terminal.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter, under a heading of glowing tube letters. Size it up if the text needs more presence.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-onest: Tilt Neon's round bowls never swell or taper anywhere. Onest keeps the thickness of its lines gently uniform beneath it, with short ascenders over big bowls, so a longer passage should move along smoothly without ink pooling in the curves.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-parkinsans: Tilt Neon brings bold, commanding tube lettering with a large x-height and short ascenders. And Parkinsans backs it up with one stroke thickness everywhere, wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, and lowercase rising close to the capitals.
